unresolved.description: The central seat-tube attachment does not fully preserve the family's smooth, even tube junction. The seat tube ends at (11.5,12.5), slightly beyond the diagonal centerline, whose y at x=11.5 is approximately 12.368. Its round cap produces a small downward bulge visible in the enlarged contours of both paints. The resolved filled SVG includes an extra cap lobe around (11.5,13.5), approximately 0.25 canonical units below the diagonal's lower boundary. Native readability survives, but this subpixel contour defect remains after the four-revision limit.
